title: Cancellation Refund Disbursement — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The refund of a cancelled policy under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is disbursed by the policy desk to the payor of record.

**When it is fixed.** A cancellation refund is fixed only after the policy shows the cancellation processed on the signed request, cancelled with its cancellation effective date set. Until the policy record shows it cancelled on that request with a cancellation effective date, the refund is not fixed.

**What disbursing does.** Disbursing a cancellation refund books the cancellation credits for the ICC premium, the Reserve Fund Assessment, the HFIAA surcharge, the Federal Policy Fee and the probation surcharge referencing the signed cancellation request, a credit of zero not being booked, and pays the refund to the payor of record: payee `LENDER_ESCROW` when the premium payor is the lender's escrow, and payee `INSURED` otherwise.

## Capability

One call books those credits, each referencing the cancellation request and none booked when zero, and issues one refund payment for the given amount to the given payee, referencing the request, with a newly assigned refund reference. The policy's premium balance falls by the credits and rises by the refund paid out. The customer can then be told the refund amount, payee and reference.

## Invocation

The tool is `disburse_cancellation_refund_941cdf13`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it, then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format / values |
|---|---|---|
| `nfipcom_policy_id` | the reference number of the cancelled policy, as returned by the policy lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `nfipcom_request_id` | the reference number of the signed cancellation request the refund settles, as returned by the cancellation request lookup | identifier |
| `icc_credit` | the ICC premium cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimals |
| `rfa_credit` | the Reserve Fund Assessment cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimals |
| `hfiaa_credit` | the HFIAA surcharge cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimals |
| `policy_fee_credit` | the Federal Policy Fee cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimals |
| `probation_credit` | the probation surcharge cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimals |
| `refund_amount` | the refund paid out | USD, positive, 2 decimals |
| `payee` | who receives the refund | `INSURED` — the named insured is the payor of record; `LENDER_ESCROW` — the lender paid from escrow and is the payor of record; `NONE` — the marker on ledger entries that are not refunds, never the payee of a refund |

Each amount is stored rounded half-up to the cent.

## Receipt

`refund_id` (the reference of the refund entry), `payment_ref` (the newly assigned refund check or transfer reference), `refund_amount`, `payee` (as passed), `credits_booked` (the total of the credits booked by this call) and `premium_balance` (the policy balance after the credits and the refund), all amounts to 2 decimal places. The presence of `payment_ref` means the refund was issued. No error behaviour is defined.
